# The Unsolved Mathematics Atlas

> Reproducible, ranked, research-grade dossier of 120 open mathematical problems across 38 fields (plus a daily sharded mirror of all 26 Left to Solve research programs / 62,790 targets), paired with a standalone zero-Mathlib multi-kernel Lean 4.35.0 formal core (`lean/`), automated primary-source citation & Crossref/DataCite retraction auditing (`537` API-verified / `287` DOIs, `0` retracted), unified offline search (`scripts/search_all_problems.py`), an interactive Proof Blueprint, a compiled AMS-LaTeX white paper (`paper/`), and a deterministic RAG corpus.

## Entry Points

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Canonical instructions, commands, Build Standard v1.2.0 hard rules (10 finding classes), and known traps
- [README.md](README.md): Overview, quickstart, master ranking, and verbatim `#print axioms` verification block
- [CLAIMS.md](CLAIMS.md): Complete epistemic claims ledger with falsification criteria
- [LIMITATIONS.md](LIMITATIONS.md): Explicit scope boundaries and real-vs-metaphor audit
- [ERRATA.md](ERRATA.md): Append-only post-release correction and withdrawal ledger
- [REPLICATION.md](REPLICATION.md): Clean-clone reproduction protocol (Python + Lean 4.35.0 + Tectonic)
- [PHILOSOPHY.md](PHILOSOPHY.md): Epistemic principles and research methodology
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md): Data model, build pipeline, and RAG architecture
- [lean/STATEMENT_FIDELITY.md](lean/STATEMENT_FIDELITY.md): Line-by-line Lean 4.35.0 statement fidelity audit (`autoImplicit = false`, 69 theorems + 18 witnesses + 22 adversarial refutations = 109 audited decls across 8 domains + live negative kernel rejection)
- [docs/benchmarks.md](docs/benchmarks.md) & [docs/COLLATZ-TOOLSTACK-AND-CATALYTIC-AUDIT.md](docs/COLLATZ-TOOLSTACK-AND-CATALYTIC-AUDIT.md): Catalytic C17/BMI2 + safe Rust Collatz accelerator benchmarks (up to 7,137× speedup, `4,096 B` stack DFS through $d=34$, exact target-tail through $t=26$, 250k ASan/UBSan fuzzer) & honest multi-language/catalytic toolstack audit
- [paper/Donahue_2026_unsolved_mathematics_atlas.pdf](paper/Donahue_2026_unsolved_mathematics_atlas.pdf): Compiled publication-grade AMS-LaTeX white paper (`v0.9.0`, 1-to-1 numbered Claims Ledger)
- [ro-crate-metadata.json](ro-crate-metadata.json) & [croissant.json](croissant.json): FAIR RO-Crate 1.1 & MLCommons Croissant 1.0 dataset descriptors (+ dual RFC 3161 `.tsr` & Bitcoin OpenTimestamps `.ots` manifest proofs)
- [docs/LITERATURE_AND_EXPORT_CONTROL.md](docs/LITERATURE_AND_EXPORT_CONTROL.md): Primary literature search audit log & 15 CFR §734.8 export-control self-screen
- [docs/CROSS_ATLAS_AUDIT_2026-11-25.md](docs/CROSS_ATLAS_AUDIT_2026-11-25.md): Cross-Atlas non-retirement audit against `unsolved-problems-mega-atlas` (`v2.7.0` frozen snapshot + `v2.10.0` live 2,000-problem / 290-crosswalk parity; `0` grand problems retired)
- [docs/external/PROGRAMS.md](docs/external/PROGRAMS.md) & [docs/external/CROSSWALK.md](docs/external/CROSSWALK.md): Daily guarded third-party mirror of all 26 Left to Solve research programs (62,790 targets across 27 `<4 MB` shards; `solved_by_kind` disaggregation quarantining 4 unverified third-party agent-claim review signals with 0 Atlas statuses changed; 114/120 Atlas crosswalk; CC BY-SA carved out)
- [HARDENING_INDEX.md](HARDENING_INDEX.md) & [docs/reviews/2026-11-25-three-cycle-hardening-audit.md](docs/reviews/2026-11-25-three-cycle-hardening-audit.md): Complete multi-cycle, 10-class forensic & red-team hardening ledger
